name: Fount of Moonlight

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

summary: Moonlight wreathes you: Resistance to Radiant, melee hits deal +2d6 Radiant, and a Reaction can Blind an attacker.
text: Cool moonlight surrounds you for the duration, shedding Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for a further 20 feet. Until the spell ends you have Resistance to Radiant damage, and your melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 Radiant damage on a hit. In addition, right after a creature you can see within 60 feet of you damages you, you can take a Reaction to make it attempt a Constitution saving throw; on a failure it has the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
